footnotes: The memory peak (118 MB) is not only an install-time figure. The cgroup's high-water mark is already 117 MB at the first sample, seconds after the install, and its memory then returns to 101 to 118 MB for one 10-second sample every 61 minutes: 24 such samples in each of runs 1 and 3, with a PSS of 116 to 132 MB in them, and none caught in run 2, as can happen with a spike shorter than the sampling interval. Between them the cgroup holds about 8 MB, which is what the idle median shows.

Idle CPU depends on the box. This row's runs on box-0 and box-6 show 0.17 and 0.19 % of one vCPU and its run on box-3 0.12 %; each of the four rows measured on these three boxes shows 1.3 to 1.5 times the idle CPU time on box-0 and box-6, and under load this row's runs on box-0, box-3 and box-6 are 0.16, 0.11 and 0.17 %. The published median (0.17 %) is therefore a box-0 or box-6 figure, while every other row was measured on boxes that idle like box-3 (Netdata's run 1 excepted). Why the two boxes differ is not established (`docs/RUN-2026-slot5.md`, "Deviations").
